title: The Avalanche Bell
text: A bell hangs over the pass to warn of avalanches, its rope frozen stiff as iron. Above it the snow leans out over the cliffs, heavy and blue and listening. One loud word could bring it all down.

options.label: Ring it, then run, and let the mountain bury whatever follows you.

outcomes.text: The snow comes down behind you like the end of the world, burying whatever was following. You flee with the cold at your heels.

options.label: Creep through in silence, beneath the leaning snow, and do not breathe.

outcomes.text: Not a flake falls. Not a breath is heard. You come out the other side shaking.
Someone coughs. The mountain answers with a roar that seems to go on forever.

options.label: The strongest cuts the bell down and takes it. Old bronze fetches a fine price.

outcomes.text: The old bronze is heavy and valuable. Without it, the pass has no warning for whoever comes after you.
